# report-studio

> Reference Next.js 16 app for MGPL Diagnostics. Its frontend pages use only @mgpl-diagnostics/client (custom UI, live previews, PDF download, a result-entry form generated from GET /templates). Its backend is one route, `src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts`, mounting `createMgplApi()` from invoice-kit. `next build` renders every page static; only the API route is dynamic.

Key facts for agents:
- Never import a kit in pages; use `src/lib/mgpl.ts` (the client). Rendering changes belong in the kits.
- Real signatures: MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE / MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE in .env.local (git-ignored).
- `src/contract-check.ts` fails typecheck if client and kit types drift.
